column3: “Set your heart to” is rendered “considered”; NASB adds “although.”
The Hebrew “bless” is a euphemism; NASB renders “curse.”
“Preserve his life” is rendered “spare his life.”
“Struck” is rendered “smote,” and “bad boils” as “sore boils.”
“In the midst of the ashes” is rendered “among the ashes.”
The Hebrew “bless” is a euphemism; NASB renders “Curse God.”
“Evil” is rendered “adversity,” and “met by appointment” as “made an appointment.”
“Toward the heavens” is rendered “toward the sky.”
